additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
300 mana, 1.25 mana regeneration and 2.5% flat base magic resistance.
17.5 main attack damage to universal heroes.
description: Bindings forged by impossible means to leash an ancient evil.
trivia: In Norse Mythology, Gleipnir is the chain that is used to bind Fenrir, a wolf that is the son of Loki and Angrboda.
Gleipnir's internal name is "Gungir", an incorrect spelling of Gungnir, which is the spear of the Norse Mythology God Odin.
tips: Gleipnir's ability to root multiple enemies at once in an area makes this item very good against heroes who rely on movement or teleport abilities to escape, as they can't be used while rooted: Phantom Assassin, Magnus, Slark, Spirit Breaker, Riki, Puck, Anti-Mage, Phantom Lancer, Techies, Void Spirit, Storm Spirit, Earth Spirit, Ember Spirit, Morphling, Meepo.

Gleipnir's ability to apply a root in an area-of-effect can reveal invisible heroes, making it very good against heroes who rely on invisible abilities and invisible items like Silver Edge and Glimmer Cape: Riki, Bounty Hunter, Slark, Nyx Assassin, Templar Assassin, Witch Doctor, Spirit Breaker, Earthshaker, Crystal Maiden, Tusk, Shadow Fiend.
Heroes who rely on Blink Dagger for mobility will not fare well against Gleipnir's root in an area: Earthshaker, Tinker, Enigma, Ursa, Axe, Pudge, Centaur Warrunner, Puck.
Remember that Gleipnir's root in an area can be easily dispelled in many ways, so you should wait for the enemies to use all of their dispels first before engaging with Gleipnir.

notes: AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.
abilities.description: Roots all enemies in a 400 radius for 2 seconds.

name: Gleipnir
